items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: they had the Luke brothers in the band, three Luke brothers

ctx.x: middle, yeah, somethin' like that. Well, I remember Louie at this Lafayette Theater, and I remember him real well because he didn't have no parts, that's what I remembered so well. He didn't have no parts to read because it's, he was the fourth trumpet added on, because they had the Luke brothers in the band, three Luke brothers -
